body.name: Deterministic RankPeel
body.construction: Initialize the current layer as \(V_0\) with \(D_0(v)=\{v\}\). Before every requested lifted query, test whether its measured endpoint pair belongs to \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\); return \(\bot\) at the first unstable pair. Otherwise, at layer \(\ell\), query \(\rho_\ell(\{v\},V_\ell\setminus\{v\})\) for every current vertex and mark its zero-rank vertices as parentless; query \(\rho_\ell(\{u,v\},V_\ell\setminus\{u,v\})\) for each unordered pair of remaining vertices and take the nontrivial connected components under \(\sim_\ell\) as blocks \(B_h\); choose the least labeled \(s_h\in B_h\); for each remaining nonpure \(c\), start with \(C=H\) and process each \(h\in H\) once, deleting \(h\) exactly when \(N_c(C\setminus\{h\})=1\); record the edges from the final \(C\) to \(c\), set \(D_{\ell+1}(h)=\bigcup_{v\in B_h}D_\ell(v)\), and recurse on \(H\). A complete run returns the accumulated graph and transcript.
